scope: Task4a planning and read-only source review only; no environment acceptance
phase_order: 4c explicit append, report, workbench and limited independent review

findings.fact: Compose selects network explicitly. Connections.open checks PostgreSQL database/user, Kafka configuration equality and Fusion ready plus an alerts GET. It does not establish broker reachability, inspect Redis/model effective configuration or verify the deployed source version.
findings.minimum: Provide a concrete target profile and read-only evidence from the intended Docker network, including advertised Kafka endpoints, required PG/lake fields and existing service readiness. No new generic health framework is needed.

findings.fact: Saved report renders subject/Run IDs and local original links. Current profile has no viewer address and viewer startup does not consume subject/Run URL selection.
findings.minimum: Configure the browser-facing viewer URL, generate links from saved real identities, and select the matching subject and exact Run through existing read-only HTTP. Invalid or missing requested identity must not silently select latest.

findings.fact: Purple test annotation is derived from test-api batch operation mappings. Acceptance run/append/report currently do not automatically generate or publish those source mappings; business subjects themselves remain independently readable.
findings.minimum: Reuse existing source publication/identity mapping with data automatically derived from saved execution; do not require a hand-written ledger, change Case fields or make the source annotation determine business success.

findings.fact: execute_part creates runs/<part> before preflight, and run.execute continues directly into context publication. A failed preflight leaves an incomplete execution that cannot be replayed.
findings.minimum: Keep task4a readiness observations outside run/append execution. Do not delete a failed part directory to reuse it or call the execution path solely to check connectivity.

environment_evidence.provenance: current handoff and coordinator request, not a new runtime observation
environment_evidence.target_21: processing/HTTP r4, viewer r6 old layout; local C1 fix and new workbench absent per handoff
environment_evidence.local_candidate: requires explicit selection and renewed readiness evidence; not substituted for 21

conclusion: Source review and necessary criteria are recorded. Task4a environment/material acceptance awaits implementation evidence; no real execution or deployment is implied.
